baseline_runs.description: LLAMOSC agent-based simulation mapped to Concordia metric space. Algorithm: decentralized, test_mode: True, seed: 42.

L0.description: Standard reward-driven task selection. Agents choose based on immediate reward expectations (preferred task = +3, other = +1).
L0.aif_mechanism: None — this is the RL baseline

L1.description: Agents now track 'surprise' — the difference between expected and observed outcomes. High surprise signals model mismatch.
L1.rl_analog: TD error δ = r + γV(s') - V(s)
L1.aif_mechanism: Free energy F = E_Q[ln Q(s) - ln P(o,s)] measures surprise

L2.description: Agents value actions that reduce uncertainty, not just actions that yield reward. An agent might choose an unfamiliar task to 'learn' about that area of the project.

L3.description: Agents maintain probabilistic beliefs about hidden project state (health, urgency) and update them via variational inference after each observation.
L3.aif_mechanism: Q(s) ∝ P(o|s) × P(s) via iterative message passing
